<antml:parameter name="zip">94128</antml:parameter>
</antml:invoke>
</antml:function_calls>

I found the order with the fleece jacket - it's order #W8367380. The order is still in pending status, so we can help you remove the fleece jacket. Since this will be a modification to the order items, I want to make sure you understand:

1. This will be our only chance to modify the items in this order
2. After modification, we won't be able to make any further changes to the items
3. The order will remain in pending status, but will be marked as "items modified"
4. You'll receive a refund of $153.18 (the cost of the fleece jacket) to your original payment method (Mastercard ending in 6081), which should process in 5-7 business days

Would you like me to proceed with removing the fleece jacket from your order? Please confirm with a "yes" if you'd like to proceed.

I notice that there actually isn't any skateboard in your order #W8367380. Your current pending order contains:
1. Dumbbell Set (55-75 lbs, iron, fixed) - $534.84
2. Bluetooth Speaker (red, 10 hours battery life) - $315.20
3. Fleece Jacket (size L, red, half zipper) - $153.18

Are you perhaps thinking of a different order? I've checked your recent orders and I don't see any skateboards. Would you still like me to proceed with just removing the fleece jacket from this order?

Let me first help you with removing the fleece jacket from order #W8367380.

<antml:function_calls>
<antml:invoke name="modify_pending_order_items">
<antml:parameter name="order_id">#W8367380</antml:parameter>

I apologize for the technical error. Since we can't directly remove an item, we'll need to cancel the entire order and place a new one. Would you like me to help you cancel this order instead? You can then place a new order with just the dumbbells and speaker.

As for your question about the grills, I can see from your order history (#W8668939) that you ordered two grills:
1. Electric Grill (medium size with rotisserie feature) - $985.66
2. Electric Grill (portable size with no additional features) - $953.39

The total amount you paid for both grills was $1,939.05.

Would you like me to proceed with canceling your current order #W8367380?

I'll help you cancel order #W8367380. Since this is a cancellation, I need to confirm a few details with you:

1. The order to be cancelled is #W8367380 containing:
   - Dumbbell Set - $534.84
   - Bluetooth Speaker - $315.20
   - Fleece Jacket - $153.18
   Total: $1,003.22

2. The refund will be processed to your original payment method (Mastercard ending in 6081) within 5-7 business days.

Please confirm with "yes" if you'd like me to proceed with the cancellation. I'll mark it as "no longer needed" as the reason for cancellation.
